title: Meet 99.5% monthly Service Portal availability
obligationText: Keep the Contoso Service Portal available at least 99.5% of each calendar month (excluding Scheduled Maintenance).
sourceClause: Service Provider shall ensure that the Service Portal achieves Availability of at least 99.5% in each calendar month.

title: Issue Contoso service credits for missed availability
obligationText: If monthly Availability falls below 99.5%, credit Contoso 5% of monthly Fees per point (or part) below target, capped at 25%, on the next invoice.
sourceClause: If Availability in any calendar month falls below 99.5%, Service Provider shall issue Customer a service credit equal to five percent (5%) of the monthly Fees for each full percentage point (or portion of a percentage point) by which Availability falls below 99.5%, up to a maximum of twenty-five percent (25%) of the monthly Fees, applied against the next invoice.
triggerEvent: Monthly Availability falls below 99.5% in a calendar month

title: Maintain insurance; send Contoso COI by Dec 15
obligationText: Maintain $2M CGL and $5M tech E&O insurance during the Term and deliver a certificate of insurance to Contoso by December 15 every year.
sourceClause: During the Term, Service Provider shall maintain commercial general liability insurance with limits of not less than $2,000,000 per occurrence and technology errors and omissions insurance with limits of not less than $5,000,000 per claim. Service Provider shall deliver to Customer a certificate of insurance evidencing the coverage required by this Section 7.1 on or before December 15 of each calendar year during the Term.

title: Protect Contoso confidential information
obligationText: Each party must keep the other's Confidential Information confidential, use it only for the Services and share it only on a need-to-know basis (survives 3 years after the Term).
sourceClause: Each Party shall hold the other Party's Confidential Information in confidence, use it only to perform or receive the Services, and disclose it only to its employees and contractors who need to know it and are bound by written confidentiality obligations at least as protective as this Article 5.

title: Cooperate with Contoso audit (30 days' notice)
obligationText: When Contoso gives at least 30 days' written audit notice (max once per 12 months), cooperate and give reasonable access to records, systems and personnel.
sourceClause: Upon not less than thirty (30) days' prior written notice, Customer or its independent auditor may audit Service Provider's records relating to the Services and the Fees, no more than once in any twelve (12) month period. Service Provider shall cooperate with any such audit and provide reasonable access to relevant records, systems and personnel during normal business hours.
triggerEvent: Contoso gives at least 30 days' written notice of an audit (no more than once per 12 months)

title: Contoso to pay invoices within 45 days
obligationText: Northwind invoices monthly in arrears; Contoso must pay each undisputed invoice within 45 days after receipt.
sourceClause: Service Provider shall invoice Customer monthly in arrears. Customer shall pay each undisputed invoice within forty-five (45) days after receipt.
triggerEvent: Contoso receives a monthly Northwind invoice

title: Send non-renewal notice to Contoso (90 days)
obligationText: Original MSA term: give written non-renewal notice at least 90 days before the current term ends (would have been 2026-12-31).
sourceClause: Either Party may elect not to renew this Agreement by giving the other Party written notice of non-renewal at least ninety (90) days before the end of the then-current Term.
reason: Amended by Amendment No. 1 Section 2: notice period is now 120 days (deadline 2026-12-01). Do not track the 90-day version.

title: Deliver quarterly service-level report (15 days)
obligationText: Original MSA term: quarterly service-level report due 15 days after quarter end (would have been 2027-01-15 for Q4 2026).
sourceClause: Service Provider shall deliver to Customer a written service-level report for each calendar quarter, showing Availability, incident counts and service credits issued, within fifteen (15) days after the end of such calendar quarter.
reason: Amended by Amendment No. 1 Section 3: report now due within 10 days after quarter end. Do not track the 15-day version.

title: Send non-renewal notice to Contoso (120 days)
obligationText: If either party does not want the MSA to auto-renew, it must give written non-renewal notice at least 120 days before the current term ends (term ends 2027-03-31, so by 2026-12-01). Otherwise the MSA renews for another year.
sourceClause: Either Party may elect not to renew this Agreement by giving the other Party written notice of non-renewal at least one hundred twenty (120) days before the end of the then-current Term.

title: Deliver quarterly service-level report to Contoso
obligationText: Send Contoso a written service-level report (availability, incidents, credits) within 10 days after each calendar quarter ends.
sourceClause: Service Provider shall deliver to Customer a written service-level report for each calendar quarter, showing Availability, incident counts and service credits issued, within ten (10) days after the end of such calendar quarter.

title: Send Contoso fee-increase notice 60 days pre-renewal
obligationText: To raise Fees (max 4%) for a Renewal Term starting on or after 2027-04-01, give Contoso written notice at least 60 days before that term starts (by 2027-01-31 for the 2027 renewal).
sourceClause: For each Renewal Term beginning on or after April 1, 2027, Service Provider may increase the Fees by up to four percent (4%) over the Fees in effect for the preceding Term, provided that Service Provider gives Customer written notice of the increase at least sixty (60) days before the start of that Renewal Term.

title: Deliver updated BCP/DR plan to Contoso
obligationText: Deliver an updated business continuity and disaster recovery plan (with RTO/RPO for the Service Portal) within 60 days after the amendment date (by 2026-10-31).
sourceClause: Within sixty (60) days after the Amendment Effective Date, Service Provider shall deliver to Customer an updated business continuity and disaster recovery plan for the Services, including recovery time and recovery point objectives for the Service Portal.

title: Pay Fabrikam monthly hosting fees (net 30)
obligationText: Pay each monthly hosting invoice ($38,500, issued on the 1st of the month) within 30 days after the invoice date; the next payment (2026-12-01) covers the 2026-11-01 invoice.
sourceClause: Provider shall invoice the Monthly Fees in advance on the first day of each calendar month. Customer shall pay each invoice within thirty (30) days after the invoice date.

title: Fabrikam: 60 days' notice and 5% cap on price increases
obligationText: Fabrikam must give at least 60 days' written notice of any fee increase; increases are limited to once per 12 months and 5% each, and an increase without notice is void. Northwind should check any increase against these limits.
sourceClause: Provider may increase the Monthly Fees no more than once in any twelve (12) month period, and no single increase may exceed five percent (5%) of the Monthly Fees then in effect. Provider shall give Customer at least sixty (60) days' prior written notice of any increase, and any increase made without such notice is void.
triggerEvent: Fabrikam proposes an increase to the Monthly Fees

title: Fabrikam to meet 99.9% monthly uptime
obligationText: Fabrikam must keep the Hosting Services at a Monthly Uptime Percentage of at least 99.9%.
sourceClause: Provider shall make the Hosting Services available with a Monthly Uptime Percentage of at least 99.9% in each calendar month.

title: Claim Fabrikam service credits within 30 days
obligationText: If monthly uptime falls below 99.9%, Northwind must submit a written Service Credit claim within 30 days after that month ends or the credit is waived.
sourceClause: To receive a Service Credit, Customer must submit a written claim to Provider within thirty (30) days after the end of the calendar month in which the Downtime occurred. Customer's failure to submit a claim within that period waives Customer's right to a Service Credit for that month.
triggerEvent: Monthly Uptime Percentage falls below 99.9% in a calendar month (claim due 30 days after that month ends)

title: Decide on Fabrikam renewal before 2027-03-31 expiry
obligationText: The hosting agreement expires 2027-03-31 and renews only by a signed written agreement before then; decide whether to renew or migrate and sign any renewal before expiry.
sourceClause: This Agreement does not renew automatically. This Agreement may be renewed or extended only by a written agreement signed by both Parties before the Expiration Date.

title: Request Fabrikam transition assistance by deadline
obligationText: To get up to 90 days of transition assistance, Northwind must request it in writing at least 60 days before the 2027-03-31 expiration (by 2027-01-30).
sourceClause: If Customer requests transition assistance by written notice delivered at least sixty (60) days before the Expiration Date, Provider shall provide up to ninety (90) days of transition assistance at its then-current professional services rates to support the migration of Customer Data and workloads to Customer or its designated successor provider.

title: Meet $750K minimum annual purchase commitment
obligationText: Buy at least $750,000 (net purchase price) of Tailspin Products in each Contract Year (July 1 - June 30); the current Contract Year ends 2027-06-30. A shortfall lets Tailspin make the appointment non-exclusive.
sourceClause: Distributor shall purchase Products having an aggregate net purchase price of not less than $750,000 during each Contract Year (the "Minimum Commitment").

title: Send Tailspin quarterly sales & inventory report
obligationText: Within 20 days after each calendar quarter, send Tailspin Net Sales by Product and state plus inventory on hand.
sourceClause: Within twenty (20) days after the end of each calendar quarter, Distributor shall deliver to Supplier a written report showing Net Sales by Product and by state for that quarter and Distributor's inventory of Products on hand at the end of that quarter.

title: Pay Tailspin marketing fund (2% of Net Sales)
obligationText: Contribute 2% of the calendar year's Net Sales of Tailspin Products to the co-op marketing fund by January 31 of the following year.
sourceClause: Distributor shall contribute to Supplier's cooperative marketing development fund an amount equal to two percent (2%) of Distributor's Net Sales of Products during each calendar year, payable on or before January 31 of the following year.

title: Submit initial marketing plan to Tailspin
obligationText: Submit an 18-month marketing plan for the Territory to Tailspin for approval within 90 days after the Effective Date (by 2026-09-29).
sourceClause: Within ninety (90) days after the Effective Date, Distributor shall submit to Supplier for approval an initial marketing plan for the Products in the Territory covering the first eighteen (18) months of the Term.

title: Observe territory exclusivity (no competing products)
obligationText: Tailspin may not appoint another distributor in WA/OR/ID/MT, and Northwind may not market or sell Competing Products in the Territory during the Term.
sourceClause: During the Term, Supplier shall not appoint any other distributor of the Products in the Territory, and Distributor shall not market or sell any Competing Products in the Territory.

title: Notify Tailspin of change of control within 30 days
obligationText: If Northwind undergoes a Change of Control (over 50% acquisition, merger or sale of substantially all assets), notify Tailspin in writing within 30 days; Tailspin may then terminate.
sourceClause: Distributor shall notify Supplier in writing within thirty (30) days after any Change of Control of Distributor.
triggerEvent: Change of Control of Northwind (acquisition of >50% of voting securities, merger, or sale of substantially all assets)

title: Pay Tailspin per dealer credit application terms
obligationText: Pay for each purchase order on the payment terms in the dealer credit application approved by Tailspin; that document isn't in the Contracts library.
sourceClause: Payment terms are those set out in the dealer credit application approved by Supplier for Distributor.
triggerEvent: Northwind places a purchase order with Tailspin (payment terms in the dealer credit application)
reason: Protected payment obligation whose terms are only in the dealer credit application, which isn't in the Contracts library: hold one item (Needs review, Low) until someone adds the document or confirms the terms.

title: Submit annual Named User true-up report to Litware
obligationText: Within 30 days after each anniversary of the 2025-11-06 Effective Date, certify to Litware the peak number of Named Users in the prior Support Year (next due 2026-12-06).
sourceClause: Within thirty (30) days after each anniversary of the Effective Date, Licensee shall deliver to Licensor a true-up report certifying the maximum number of Named Users who had access to the Software at any time during the preceding Support Year.

title: Pay Litware annual support fee
obligationText: Pay the $84,000 annual Support Fee on or before the first day of each Support Year (next Support Year starts 2027-11-06); Litware invoices at least 45 days ahead.
sourceClause: Licensor shall issue its invoice for each Support Year at least forty-five (45) days before the start of that Support Year, and Licensee shall pay the Support Fee on or before the first day of that Support Year.

title: Send Litware support non-renewal notice (60 days)
obligationText: Support auto-renews each Support Year; to stop it, give written notice at least 60 days before the next Support Year starts (by 2027-09-07).
sourceClause: Support Services renew automatically for successive Support Years unless Licensee gives Licensor written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days before the start of the next Support Year.

title: No use of Litware software by affiliates or third parties
obligationText: Do not let any Affiliate or third party access or use the Software, and do not sublicense, rent, offer it as a service or reverse engineer it.
sourceClause: Licensee shall not permit any Affiliate or other third party to access or use the Software. Licensee shall not sublicense, rent or lease the Software, use it to provide services to third parties, or reverse engineer it except to the extent permitted by applicable law.

title: Cooperate with Litware license audit
obligationText: When Litware gives at least 15 business days' written notice (max once per 12 months), cooperate with the license audit and give reasonable access to records and systems.
sourceClause: Licensor may, no more than once in any twelve (12) month period and upon at least fifteen (15) business days' prior written notice, audit Licensee's use of the Software to verify compliance with this Agreement. Licensee shall cooperate with any such audit and provide reasonable access to relevant records and systems.
triggerEvent: Litware gives at least 15 business days' written notice of an audit (no more than once per 12 months)

title: Bear own negotiation costs
obligationText: Each party pays its own costs of negotiating and signing the agreement.
sourceClause: Each Party shall bear its own costs and expenses incurred in connection with the negotiation, preparation and execution of this Agreement.
reason: Routine boilerplate: the costs were incurred at signing and no post-signature action, date or deliverable exists.

title: Proseware: notify personal data breach within 48 hours
obligationText: Proseware must notify Northwind of any Personal Data Breach without undue delay and no later than 48 hours after becoming aware of it.
sourceClause: Processor shall notify Controller of any Personal Data Breach without undue delay and in any event within forty-eight (48) hours after becoming aware of it.
triggerEvent: Proseware becomes aware of a Personal Data Breach

title: Object to new Proseware sub-processor within 15 days
obligationText: When Proseware gives notice of a new Sub-processor, Northwind must send any written objection within 15 days after receiving it, or the Sub-processor is deemed approved.
sourceClause: If Controller objects to a new Sub-processor on reasonable data protection grounds, Controller shall notify Processor of its objection in writing within fifteen (15) days after receiving Processor's notice. If Controller does not object within that period, the new Sub-processor is deemed approved.
triggerEvent: Northwind receives Proseware's notice of a new Sub-processor

title: Proseware: 30 days' notice before new sub-processor
obligationText: Proseware must give at least 30 days' written notice (identity, location, processing) before engaging any new Sub-processor.
sourceClause: Processor shall give Controller at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice before engaging any new Sub-processor, identifying the Sub-processor, its location and the processing it will perform.
triggerEvent: Proseware plans to engage a new Sub-processor

title: Obtain Proseware's initial SOC 2 Type II report
obligationText: Proseware must deliver its most recent SOC 2 Type II report within 30 days after the DPA Effective Date (by 2026-10-01); chase if not received.
sourceClause: Processor shall deliver to Controller a copy of its most recent SOC 2 Type II report no later than thirty (30) days after the DPA Effective Date.

title: Obtain Proseware's annual SOC 2 Type II report
obligationText: After the initial report, Proseware must deliver an updated SOC 2 Type II report by October 1 every year.
sourceClause: Thereafter, Processor shall deliver to Controller an updated SOC 2 Type II report on or before October 1 of each year during the term of this DPA.

title: Proseware: return or delete personal data at termination
obligationText: On termination of the Services Agreement, Proseware must return and delete Personal Data as set out in Section 11.4 of the Services Agreement, which isn't in the Contracts library.
sourceClause: Return and deletion of Personal Data upon termination of the Services Agreement is governed by Section 11.4 of the Services Agreement.
triggerEvent: Termination of the Services Agreement
reason: Protected data-return obligation whose terms are only in the Services Agreement (Section 11.4), which isn't in the Contracts library: hold one item (Needs review, Low) until someone adds the document or confirms the terms.

title: Pay monthly base rent to Alpine Ski House
obligationText: Pay $42,750 Monthly Base Rent in advance on or before the 1st of every month, without deduction (late charge after 5 days).
sourceClause: Tenant shall pay Monthly Base Rent in advance, without demand, deduction or offset, on or before the first (1st) day of each calendar month during the Term.

title: Restore security deposit within 10 days of demand
obligationText: If the landlord uses any of the $85,500 Security Deposit to cure a Northwind default, top it back up within 10 days after the landlord's written demand.
sourceClause: If Landlord applies any part of the Security Deposit to cure a default by Tenant, Tenant shall restore the Security Deposit to its full amount within ten (10) days after Landlord's written demand.
triggerEvent: Landlord applies the Security Deposit to a Tenant default and sends a written demand

title: Exercise lease renewal option (window closes Dec 30)
obligationText: To extend the lease for 5 years, deliver written notice no earlier than 2026-09-30 and no later than 2026-12-30 (12 to 9 months before the 2027-09-30 expiration). Missing the window forfeits the option.
sourceClause: Tenant may exercise the renewal option only by delivering written notice to Landlord no earlier than twelve (12) months and no later than nine (9) months before the Expiration Date. If Tenant does not deliver notice within that period, the renewal option lapses and is of no further force or effect.

title: Maintain insurance; send landlord COI by Jan 15
obligationText: Keep $2M CGL and full-replacement property insurance in force and deliver a certificate naming the landlord as additional insured by January 15 each year.
sourceClause: Tenant shall maintain, throughout the Term, commercial general liability insurance with limits of not less than $2,000,000 per occurrence and property insurance covering Tenant's personal property at full replacement cost. Tenant shall deliver to Landlord a certificate of insurance evidencing the coverage required by this Section 5.1, naming Landlord as an additional insured, on or before January 15 of each calendar year during the Term.

title: Report needed repairs to landlord within 10 days
obligationText: Notify the landlord in writing of any condition in the Premises that needs landlord repair within 10 days after discovering it.
sourceClause: Tenant shall notify Landlord in writing of any condition in the Premises requiring repair by Landlord within ten (10) days after Tenant discovers the condition.
triggerEvent: Northwind discovers a condition in the Premises requiring repair by the landlord

title: Wide World: 90 days' notice before discontinuing product
obligationText: Wide World must give at least 90 days' written notice before discontinuing any Product and accept last-time-buy orders during that period.
sourceClause: Supplier shall give Buyer at least ninety (90) days' prior written notice before discontinuing any Product, and shall accept last-time-buy Purchase Orders for the discontinued Product submitted during that notice period.
triggerEvent: Wide World decides to discontinue a Product

title: Send Wide World rolling 6-month forecast by the 5th
obligationText: By the 5th of every month, send Wide World a non-binding rolling 6-month forecast for each Product.
sourceClause: On or before the fifth (5th) day of each calendar month, Buyer shall provide Supplier with a rolling six (6) month non-binding forecast of its anticipated requirements for each Product.

title: Notify Wide World of defects within 14 days of delivery
obligationText: Inspect each delivery and give written notice of any Defect within 14 days after delivery; otherwise the Products are deemed accepted (except latent Defects).
sourceClause: Buyer shall notify Supplier in writing of any Defect within fourteen (14) days after delivery of the affected Products. Products for which Buyer gives no notice of Defect within that period are deemed accepted, except for latent Defects that could not reasonably have been discovered on inspection.
triggerEvent: Each delivery of Products to Northwind (notice due within 14 days after delivery)

title: Hold annual price review with Wide World by Oct 31
obligationText: Meet with Wide World by October 31 each year to review next year's Product pricing; agreed changes take effect January 1 via a signed updated Exhibit A.
sourceClause: Each year during the Term, the Parties shall meet no later than October 31 to review Product pricing for the following calendar year.

title: Pay Wide World invoices within 45 days
obligationText: Pay each undisputed Wide World invoice (issued on delivery) within 45 days after receiving it.
sourceClause: Buyer shall pay each undisputed invoice within forty-five (45) days after receipt of the invoice.
triggerEvent: Northwind receives a Wide World invoice (issued at each delivery)

title: Pay Adventure Works quarterly volume rebate
obligationText: For each quarter with Net Purchases over $150,000, pay Adventure Works a 3% rebate with a calculation statement within 45 days after quarter end (Q4 2026 rebate survives expiry).
sourceClause: Reseller shall pay each rebate earned under Section 3.1, together with a statement showing its calculation, within forty-five (45) days after the end of the applicable calendar quarter.

title: Maintain most-favored-customer pricing
obligationText: During the Term, Northwind's prices to Adventure Works must be no less favorable than prices offered to any Similarly Situated Customer.
sourceClause: During the Term, Reseller shall offer Customer prices for the Products that are no less favorable than the prices Reseller offers to any Similarly Situated Customer.

title: Extend better pricing to Adventure Works within 30 days
obligationText: If Northwind offers better prices to a Similarly Situated Customer, notify Adventure Works in writing within 30 days and extend those prices retroactively to the date first offered.
sourceClause: If Reseller offers more favorable prices for a Product to a Similarly Situated Customer, Reseller shall notify Customer in writing within thirty (30) days and extend the more favorable prices to Customer from the date they were first offered to the other customer.
triggerEvent: Northwind offers more favorable Product pricing to a Similarly Situated Customer

title: Decide on Adventure Works renewal before expiry
obligationText: The agreement expires 2026-12-31 with no automatic renewal; any renewal needs a signed written agreement, so decide and negotiate before expiry.
sourceClause: This Agreement begins on January 1, 2024 and expires on December 31, 2026. This Agreement does not renew automatically, and any renewal or extension requires a written agreement signed by both Parties.

title: Adventure Works: pay per standard credit terms
obligationText: Adventure Works pays for its purchase orders on Northwind's standard credit terms approved for it; those terms aren't in the Contracts library.
sourceClause: Payment terms are set out in Reseller's standard credit terms approved for Customer.
triggerEvent: Adventure Works places a purchase order (payment terms in Northwind's standard credit terms)
reason: Protected payment obligation whose terms are only in Northwind's standard credit terms, which aren't in the Contracts library: hold one item (Needs review, Low) until someone adds the document or confirms the terms.

title: Give 60 days' notice to terminate for convenience
obligationText: Either party can end the cafe agreement for convenience, but only with at least 60 days' prior written notice.
sourceClause: Either Party may terminate this Agreement for convenience by giving the other Party at least sixty (60) days' prior written notice.
triggerEvent: Either party decides to terminate the agreement for convenience

title: Obtain Fourth Coffee food-safety certificate by Mar 1
obligationText: Fourth Coffee must deliver its annual third-party food-safety inspection certificate to Northwind by March 1 each year.
sourceClause: Supplier shall deliver to Customer a copy of its annual food-safety inspection certificate, issued by an accredited third-party inspector, by March 1 of each year.

title: Supplier staff wear uniforms and badges
obligationText: Cafe staff wear uniforms and ID badges.
sourceClause: Supplier staff shall wear uniforms and visible identification badges while working at the Cafe.
reason: Routine administration: no deadline, deliverable or business consequence for a contract manager to track.

title: Designate a point of contact
obligationText: Each party names a day-to-day point of contact.
sourceClause: Each Party shall designate a point of contact for day-to-day communications regarding the Services (each, a "Point of Contact").
reason: Routine administration: no deadline, deliverable or business consequence for a contract manager to track.

title: Send invoices to accounts payable mailbox
obligationText: Catering invoices go to accounts.payable@northwind.example.
sourceClause: Invoices shall be sent to accounts.payable@northwind.example.
reason: Routine administration: no deadline, deliverable or business consequence for a contract manager to track.

title: Cooperate in good faith
obligationText: The parties cooperate in good faith.
sourceClause: The Parties shall cooperate in good faith in the performance of this Agreement.
reason: Routine administration: no deadline, deliverable or business consequence for a contract manager to track.

title: Issue contractor access badges to cafe staff
obligationText: Cafe staff receive contractor badges under Northwind's standard access procedures.
sourceClause: Supplier staff will be issued contractor access badges under Customer's standard visitor and contractor access procedures.
reason: Routine administration: no deadline, deliverable or business consequence for a contract manager to track.

title: Headings are for convenience only
obligationText: Interpretive boilerplate; headings do not affect meaning.
sourceClause: Headings are for convenience only and do not affect the interpretation of this Agreement.
reason: Interpretive boilerplate, not an obligation of either party.

title: Deliver quarterly compliance certificate to Woodgrove
obligationText: Within 45 days after each fiscal quarter end (starting with the quarter ending 2026-12-31), deliver a CFO-signed compliance certificate and unaudited quarterly financials (first due 2027-02-14).
sourceClause: Within forty-five (45) days after the end of each fiscal quarter of the Borrower, commencing with the fiscal quarter ending December 31, 2026, the Borrower shall deliver to the Bank a compliance certificate signed by its chief financial officer, together with unaudited consolidated financial statements for that quarter, demonstrating compliance with Section 4.1.

title: Deliver annual audited financials to Woodgrove
obligationText: Within 120 days after each June 30 fiscal year end (starting FY ending 2027-06-30), deliver unqualified audited consolidated financial statements (first due 2027-10-28).
sourceClause: Within one hundred twenty (120) days after the end of each fiscal year of the Borrower, which ends on June 30, commencing with the fiscal year ending June 30, 2027, the Borrower shall deliver to the Bank audited consolidated financial statements reported on without qualification by an independent certified public accounting firm.

title: Maintain minimum liquidity of $5,000,000
obligationText: Keep unrestricted cash held at Woodgrove of at least $5,000,000 at all times (tested each quarter end).
sourceClause: The Borrower shall maintain Liquidity of not less than $5,000,000 at all times.

title: Notify Woodgrove of any default within 5 business days
obligationText: Notify the bank in writing within 5 Business Days after any officer learns of a Default or Event of Default, describing it and the proposed response.
sourceClause: The Borrower shall notify the Bank in writing within five (5) Business Days after any officer of the Borrower becomes aware of any Default or Event of Default, describing it and the action the Borrower proposes to take.
triggerEvent: Any Northwind officer becomes aware of a Default or Event of Default

title: Pay monthly interest on Woodgrove advances
obligationText: Pay accrued interest on outstanding Advances monthly in arrears on the 1st of each month.
sourceClause: The Borrower shall pay accrued interest on all outstanding Advances monthly in arrears on the first (1st) day of each calendar month.

title: Repay all Woodgrove advances at maturity
obligationText: Repay all outstanding Advances plus accrued interest on the Maturity Date (2029-09-15).
sourceClause: The Borrower shall repay all outstanding Advances, together with accrued and unpaid interest, on the Maturity Date.

title: Deliver insurance endorsements to Woodgrove
obligationText: Post-closing: deliver lender's loss payable and additional insured endorsements on property and liability policies within 60 days after the 2026-09-15 Closing Date (by 2026-11-14).
sourceClause: Within sixty (60) days after the Closing Date, the Borrower shall deliver to the Bank lender's loss payable and additional insured endorsements, in form satisfactory to the Bank, under the Borrower's property and general liability insurance policies.

title: Pay facility and legal fees at closing
obligationText: Closing-date condition: pay the $25,000 facility fee and the bank's legal fees on the Closing Date.
sourceClause: As a condition to the effectiveness of this Agreement, the Borrower shall pay the Bank, on the Closing Date, a facility fee of $25,000 and the Bank's reasonable legal fees incurred in preparing this Agreement.
reason: Condition to effectiveness satisfied at closing on 2026-09-15 (the facility is in effect); no post-signature action remains.

title: Counterparts clause
obligationText: Execution mechanics only.
sourceClause: This Agreement may be executed in counterparts, each of which is an original and all of which together constitute one instrument.
reason: Routine boilerplate about how the agreement is signed; no obligation to track.
